procedure: Bind observations, model results and authorized reconciliation basis.
Align supported calendars, currency, scale, definitions and perimeter.
Trace signed bridges, residuals and duplicate attribution.
Return metric bindings and unresolved reconciliation/domain work.

acceptance.expectation: Transformed metrics resolve to original inputs, formulas, units, conversion evidence and current model paths; signed bridge arithmetic and residuals are actually checked.
Underlying event/exposure IDs link all affected bridges and outcomes, with reused amounts and duplicate-treatment flags preserved.
Calendar, stock/flow, currency, scale, definition and ownership/perimeter alignments are justified; no unsupported plug, normalization or causal inference closes a difference.
Supplied consolidation, NCI, lease and share-right policies reconcile by unit and attribution, without choosing missing policies.

conditions: Required source or execution tool unavailable
Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; identify affected record, evidence/test, consequence, next action and conclusion restriction

artifact_alias_semantics: Logical plan output names for the corresponding method records, not extra completed artifacts. Preserve unit, current version and actual completion/review state; a design or formula specification is not an executed model or reconciled numerical bridge.
